title: Yoga and Croissants
long_description:
Free fitness at Allstonway

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events6/banners/6a8cb1a0-c2c4-11f1-b12c-ed14d8d18e75-rimg-w1110-h740-dce8e8e8-gmir.jpg 

Join us for an outdoor yoga class with Tobias Stohrr and Swissbakers! After you downward dog and savasana, enjoy some of the neighborhood's best croissants! 

Class Overviews:
Vinyasa Flow with Tobey: Find Your Center. Elevate Your Awareness. Join Tobey for an all-levels Vinyasa practice designed to help you reconnect with what you truly need, both physically and mentally.
In this class, we will move through a fluid Vinyasa sequence, prioritizing the union of mind, body, and breath. Whether you are a seasoned yogi or brand new to the practice, you’ll find a supportive environment focused on self-discovery and functional movement. The goal is simple: to leave the mat feeling better than when you arrived.
What to Expect:
Style: Vinyasa Flow (Movement linked to breath)
Focus: Mental clarity, physical grounding, and heightened body awareness.
Community: A welcoming space for all levels to move and connect.
Level: Open to all practitioners. Come as you are.

This event is free to attend and open to the public. Please RSVP so we can communicate any changes or weather cancellations.

Allstonway is a new, dynamic public space on Western Avenue. Allstonway provides visitors opportunities to connect with welcoming, inclusive and multi-faceted public open spaces, year-round programming and events, and ongoing public art exhibits.
